headlines.title: BofA cuts Intel to Neutral, says turnaround pushed out by PC weakness
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America downgraded Intel to Neutral from Buy and cut its price target to $100 from $145 in a note Friday, telling investors that a sharp drop in PC shipments and supply constraints have pushed out the chipmaker’s turnaround.

headlines.title: Bank of America vs. Goldman Sachs: Two Wall Street Giants, Two Very Different Revenue Stories
headlines.summary: Bank of America and Goldman Sachs are two of Wall Street's biggest names, but their quarterly revenue trends reveal an important difference in how these financial giants generate income.

headlines.title: Alphabet just had its worst day as a public company. BofA now values Google search at a lower multiple than fossil fuel stocks
headlines.summary: Search revenue missed forecasts and free cash flow went negative. Bank of America now values Google’s core search business at about 10 times earnings, against 18.7 for the S&P 500.

headlines.title: Bank of America Names Top Stock Pick in Memory Sector
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America has highlighted Micron Technology as its top stock pick, maintaining a buy rating with a price objective of $1,550, significantly above the current trading price of $877.55.

headlines.title: HubSpot faces narrower growth beat and possible guidance cut, BofA says
headlines.summary: HubSpot (NYSE:HUBS), the customer relationship management platform, is likely to deliver a smaller-than-usual beat against its third-quarter constant currency growth guidance, Bank of America (BofA) said, maintaining its 'underperform' rating.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
